_comment: What scripts/build-deb.sh writes to usr/share/doc/amberfader/copyright (DEP-5) and
SOURCES.txt, through scripts/deb-copyright.py. Third-Party-Notices.txt next to them
comes from scripts/python-notices.py. Paths are relative to this file.
deb-copyright.py writes the component paragraphs sorted by name, and in DEP-5 the
last matching Files paragraph wins: the names keep narrower paths after wider ones.
The FFmpeg and ICU versions are the ones the PySide6 6.11.2 wheels bundle; re-check
them with every PySide6 bump (python-notices.toml pins the version).

components.name: Bundled Python packages
components.license_text: Each package keeps its own license (MIT, PSF-2.0, LGPL-3.0 and others). Their full license texts, copyright notices and source links are in Third-Party-Notices.txt, next to this file; the Rust standard library compiled into rpds-py has its notices in Rust-Licenses.html.
copyright: The authors of each package, as listed in Third-Party-Notices.txt

components.name: PySide6, shiboken6 and Qt

components.comment: Qt and PySide6 are available under LGPL-3.0-only, GPL-2.0-only or GPL-3.0-only. Qt's add-on modules that are only available under GPL-3.0-only (Charts, Graphs, Quick 3D, Virtual Keyboard and others) and its tools (designer, linguist, qml and others: GPL-3.0-only WITH Qt-GPL-exception-1.0) are included. Qt WebEngine includes Chromium; Third-Party-Notices.txt lists Qt's third-party components with their texts. The Qt libraries are separate shared objects and can be replaced.

components.name: Python package amberfader
components.comment: Amberfader's own code, installed with its dependencies.

components.name: Qt Multimedia's FFmpeg
components.comment: Built by Qt without FFmpeg's optional GPL and LGPL-3.0 parts. Some FFmpeg files are under BSD, ISC, MIT or MPL-2.0 terms; Third-Party-Notices.txt has them in Qt's FFmpeg attribution. The libraries are separate shared objects and can be replaced.
